tamoyo1.name: MB-3 Tamoyo 1
tamoyo1.authority: Main ruled the Brazil line on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("lets build brazil, not taiwan, and flesh it out with all its own tanks"): the Tamoyo 1 at tier II, a photo-class first-party build on the Bernardini hull; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
tamoyo1.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the Tamoyo build (profiles/tamoyo.ts): published 6.5 m hull, 8.77 m over the 90 mm BR3, 3.22 m wide, 2.2 m to the turret roof and 2.5 m over the MG (Tanks Encyclopedia after Bastos); stations from Vesp's profile scaled on the hull (its roof reads 2.29 m, recorded as a conflict). The envelope holds the side plates' bolt strips, the mirrors, the .50 on the cupola and the antenna whips.
